EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF MALUKU PROVINCE
NUMBER 04 YEAR 2017
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Various acts of violence both against women and children within the household and outside the household continue to increase from time to time. This condition, if without serious handling, will destroy household life, society, nation and state. Therefore, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.

Protection of women and children from acts of violence is the obligation of Regional Government as regulated in article 22 letter a, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Regional Government which states "that in carrying out regional autonomy has the obligation to protect the community, maintain unity, oneness and national harmony as well as the integrity of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia".

On that basis, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency has taken steps as an effort to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence, however it has not been able to provide maximum and adequate protection against acts of violence that occur in the social life of the community, particularly to women and children, among others caused by the still low understanding of the community regarding the rights of women and children, handling has not been well coordinated, implementation has not been sustainable and so forth. Therefore, a regulation in the form of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is needed to answer while at the same time providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children victims from acts of violence that occur.

The existence of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence, gives responsibility to the Regional Government starting from the prevention of acts of violence to the handling of victims of acts of violence. In its implementation the Regional Government cooperates with government agencies and the community. In addition, adequate funding support from the Regional Government and community participation, it is hoped that violence against women and children can be reduced and even in time will be eliminated from the face of this beloved West Southeast Maluku.

Article 3
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of gender-based violence and the best interests of children that occur in the household and/or public sphere.

Article 10
The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 7 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of acts of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 18
The community may conduct supervision of the implementation of protection for women and child victims of violence organized by the Regional Government through a mechanism of conveying aspirations to the Regent or to the DPRD.

VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Various acts of violence both against women and children within the household and outside the household continue to increase from time to time. This condition, if without serious handling, will destroy household life, society, nation and state. Therefore, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.

Protection of women and children from acts of violence is the obligation of Regional Government as regulated in article 22 letter a, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Regional Government which states "that in carrying out regional autonomy has the obligation to protect the community, maintain unity, oneness and national harmony as well as the integrity of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia".

Therefore, a regulation in the form of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is needed to answer while at the same time providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children victims from acts of violence that occur.

The existence of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence, gives responsibility to the Regional Government starting from the prevention of acts of violence to the handling of victims of acts of violence. In its implementation the Regional Government cooperates with government agencies and the community. In addition, adequate funding support from the Regional Government and community participation, it is hoped that violence against women and children can be reduced and even in time will be eliminated from the face of this beloved West Southeast Maluku.

Therefore, a regulation in the form of a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence is needed to answer while at the same time providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children victims from acts of violence that occur.
